description: A book file the account keeps for reading in Resenha: an EPUB, a PDF or a comic archive. The file is a blob in the account's repository, which keeps it only while a record refers to it.

main.description: One per file. Deleting the record lets the account's server delete the file.

format.description: How to open the file. A comic archive is a zip of page images, read in file name order.

title.description: From the file's own metadata when it has some, otherwise from its file name.

cover.description: A cover image for showing the book in a list, taken from the file.

book.description: The account's buzz.bookhive.book record for the same book, when the reader connected the file to their library.
